title: Weather-Sensitive Routine Failure Map
dataSources: Cross-stream correlations (`correlation:pair`), anomaly-day rollups (`anomalyday:score`), personal SLA checks (`personalsla:status`), and daily life scores (`lifescore:daily`).
app: Meta-monitoring for every `index=personal` stream, turning cross-signal correlations, anomaly-day scoring, and personal SLA dashboards into Splunk-native analytics.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=correlation:pair
| search left_domain="weather"
| stats avg(correlation_score) as avg_correlation_score count as windows by weather_factor routine_name
| sort 0 - avg_correlation_score
description: Ranks weather-routine pairss by weather-sensitive routine failures.
value: A weather failure map shows which routines genuinely depend on conditions and deserve a fallback plan.
implementation: Send weather-sensitive routine failures events to `index=personal` and keep `weather_factor` populated so the leaderboard stays actionable.
visualization: Bar chart of weather-sensitive routine failures by weather-routine pairs.
grandmaExplanation: It monitors which weather-routine pairss stand out most for weather-sensitive routine failures.
